headline: Soybean and Soy Oil Prices Fall Sharp on US Harvest and Weak Real
summary: International soybean futures dropped $15 per tonne while soy oil prices plunged over $80 during the week. The decline was driven by incoming US crop harvests, lower crude prices, and real depreciation.
why: Soybeans are a primary global agricultural commodity, serving as a key export driver for North and South American economies.

impacts.name: Soybean Futures
impacts.why: Increased harvest supply from North America and foreign exchange pressure pushed futures lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Seasonal US harvest influxes and falling global oil benchmarks depressed agricultural commodity futures.
